sinopsis.es: Retrata la historia de León Ramírez e Isabel Velásquez, dos ancianos de casi 90 años que atienden una tienda de barrio para sobrevivir. El cortometraje aborda de forma íntima y crítica temas como la resignación de la vejez, el abandono a la tercera edad, el desarraigo territorial y los impactos colaterales del conflicto armado en Colombia (abusos del Estado, ELN y AUC).
sinopsis.en: A hybrid documentary of denunciation and reflection about León Ramírez and Isabel Velásquez, an elderly couple worn down by the land that once gave them joy and now slowly kills them through state abuse. At nearly 90, they still run a small store to survive. Their land, ravaged by armed groups and state policies, is now a purgatory where fruit rots on the ground. Powerless, they close their shop and bury themselves alive in their land, embodying old age, abandonment, uprootedness and resistance.
